req-brueghel-hearing: The seated figure quietly plays an instrument. Room, furnishings, displayed objects and the view outside form an extensive surrounding place.
req-brueghel-smell: The foreground figures quietly handle or examine flowers. Garden paths, planted beds, architecture and distant grounds dominate the environment.
req-brueghel-taste: Figures quietly reach around the laden table and birds forage. Interior, terrace and deep garden create an extensive surrounding place.
req-brueghel-touch: The foreground figures quietly touch or handle objects. Armoured displays, room, drapery and the outdoor opening construct an extensive place.
req-patinir-massys-temptations: Figures reach, offer objects, bend and handle vessels across the scene. Rocks, terrain, buildings and water create an extensive landscape.
req-caravaggio-david-borghese: The standing figure quietly holds a severed head and lowered blade after the violence. The dark field does not depict an environmental place.
req-dore-quixote-library: Many imagined figures visibly fight, reach and ride around the seated reader. Books, walls and furnishings establish a substantial interior.
req-birkhauser-worlds-wound: The divided portrait holds a still pose. The unlocated dark field does not establish an environmental place.
req-rivera-controller-universe: Painted figures reach, operate machinery and handle objects. Fragmentary city, crowd and natural passages give some surrounding place within the montage.
req-rivera-alameda: Most painted figures stand with quiet gestures. Trees and park grounds create a substantial setting; photographed museum visitors are excluded from this judgement.
req-siqueiros-new-democracy: Painted bodies thrust their arms, strain and break restraints. Abstract planes and flames do not establish an extended physical place.
req-orozco-prometheus: The large figure extends both arms overhead and surrounding bodies reach and bend. Flames and colour fields do not depict a developed environmental place; photographed architectural framing is excluded.
req-orozco-man-fire: The painted bodies twist and tumble. Surrounding photographed dome architecture is the mural's support, not a place depicted inside the painting.
req-orozco-cortes-malinche: One seated figure extends an arm across the other while a lower body lies still. Abstract support planes do not establish a surrounding place; photographed vault and stair architecture are excluded.
req-orozco-katharsis: Many painted figures grapple, struggle and handle objects. Fragmentary machinery and ground give limited place around the dense bodies.
req-camarena-liberacion: Painted figures strain, reach and extend their arms across broken restraints. Geometric planes and symbolic structures do not establish a surrounding physical place.
